She gave birth to twins on a winter night: a baby boy, and a dragon. To save her dragon son, the queen must hide him from her own husband, the king.

THE QUEEN'S MONSTER is a full-length medieval fantasy movie about a mother's love, a dark secret and a dragon that should never have been born. When Queen Mira's twins arrive, one is a human prince and the other is a baby dragon with charcoal scales and amber eyes. King Aldric fears monsters, and a dragon born in the castle means death. So Mira hides the dragon in a ruined tower across the river, sneaks out every night to feed him and sings him the lullaby she sings his brother.

The dragon Ash grows up in secret, and the queen teaches him the one rule that keeps him alive: never fire. But a castle has eyes. A straw in a cradle, a servant who heard too much and a king who asks quiet questions slowly close in on the queen's secret. When the truth comes out, a mother has to choose between her crown, her husband and the son the world calls a monster.

Years later, the human twin Rowan finds the dragon brother he never knew he had, and the two of them take to the sky.
